ns2:course.label: Current Art Issues Seminar
ns2:course.description: Seminar with readings, lectures, discussions on ideas and issues affecting contemporary art. Attendance is required at visiting artists' and scholars' lectures and field trips. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Fine and Applied Arts or consent of instructor.
